clusters.pick_reason: #2215 is the more complete fix: it extracts the normalization into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper and also corrects `shouldAttemptFallback` to check `pathname === ''` instead of `pathname === '/'`. After the regex normalization, a root URL's pathname becomes `''` not `'/'`, so #2214's version leaves `shouldAttemptFallback` silently broken — root-path fallback suppression no longer fires, potentially causing an extra redundant discovery request on every root-URL server.
